text_block_list.text:
After school, I spotted Ikuno Dictus
and Matikanetannhauser on the outdoor stage.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*... My legs are completely wobbly~...
This song really is super tough after all, ughhh~...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... This choreography is
quite physically demanding...
choice_data_list: Looks tough, are you two doing alright?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer from the other day...
Thank you for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We have an upcoming mini-live and are practicing
the new song we are scheduled to perform, however...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The tempo is fast, there are so many moves,
and it's crazy hard~... *siiigh*...

I nodded in understanding.
With a new song, they had to learn everything from scratch.
A difficult track would only make it harder.
choice_data_list: Try not to push yourselves too hard.
Don't push yourselves too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice.
In truth, my body is reaching its limit as well,
so perhaps we should call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There is still time before the actual performance,
and I have business to attend to.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Ikuno, where are you going?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To my duties for the General Affairs Committee.
Today's equipment inspection has yet to be completed.
—Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehh~~, right now...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, her fatigue must be piling up...
Maybe I should go check on her?

Together with Matikanetannhauser,
I decided to go check on Ikuno Dictus.

—With that thought in mind, we arrived at the room.
There, an unexpected sight awaited us.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Seven, eight, nine... What is the meaning of this!?
There is one extra hammer!???

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, Baku-chan.
Look, items of different sizes just got mixed in.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: If we separate each kind—see, the count matches!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Eh...?
Why are the two of you conducting equipment inspection?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well!!
Excellent work today, Ikuno-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you caught us♪
We were planning to do it secretly, though.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...They said they'd do it in your place
because you seemed overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For Ikuno-san, who always assists us with such diligence,
this Class President is boundlessly grateful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I have come today to repay the favor!
For never forgetting a debt of gratitude is the hallmark of a Class President!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the tools Ikuno-chan manages
are always spotless, letting all of us shine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So this time, it's Ikuno-chan's turn to shine.
Right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (—I was able to come this far thanks to the support of so many people and the proper equipment.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (If our feeling of gratitude toward them created this very situation...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...
I will never let everyone's goodwill go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Up next is our new song!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Adorned by this stage and these costumes, supported by the warm consideration of so many—
We have finally reached this very moment!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: We shall perform with all our heart and sincerity, so please enjoy the show!
At the mini-live held afterwards, Ikuno Dictus and the others delivered a wonderful performance.
Thus, they were brilliantly able to demonstrate the fruits of their practice.
